rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax printed '0.75% (פריים - 4.00%)'. Row 'פיקדון ל-3 חודשים (90 יום)', rate type 'משתנה', linkage 'לא צמוד', amount '500,000 ש"ח ומעלה', break 'אין אפשרות לשבירה', automatic renewal 'קיימת', number of renewals 'עד 5 (ולא יותר מ-540 יום)', exit points 'לא קיימת'. This row as printed: '500,000 ש"ח ומעלה': '0.75% (פריים - 4.00%)'. Read 2026-11-09 from board 13_26 ('בתוקף מיום 06/10/2026'), the file the bank's deposits page links today (https://www.bank-yahav.co.il/investments/deposits/); p.6 also prints '24/09/2026 11_26' under the date. The common-deposit column is empty on every row.

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.

break.mechanism_text: 'אפשרות לשבירת פיקדון: אין אפשרות לשבירה' (447 table column, printed once for every row). The account agreement (s.6.1.1, p.36) says that if the bank allows an early withdrawal 'לפנים משורת הדין', the money withdrawn bears no interest or linkage and the bank may charge 'בסכום השווה לנזק שיגרם לבנק' (BANK-33, BANK-48).
